turns_policy.definition: number of normalized messages strictly before target_message_id

inclusion_policy: Derive applicable_rqs deterministically: RQ1 and RQ2 require a relevant historical Requirement; RQ3 requires an affected target transition; an RQ4 candidate requires an affected transition and a matching target Code Environment.

excluded_targets.detail: The target introduces only REQ_SUPPORT_CONTACT_FORM and has no historical Requirement for RQ1 selection or RQ2 reconstruction. Preserve it in Stage 2 and exclude it only from the main RQ1-RQ3 Phase A cohort.
